name: @tiangz/native-language-core
description: TiangZ .native 语言共享的解析器、AST、校验器与代码生成命名投影
author: moulo

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:codegen
scripts.build:extension: npm run typecheck --workspace tiangz-native-language && npm run build --workspace tiangz-native-language
scripts.test:core: npm run build && node --test packages/language-core/test/*.test.mjs packages/codegen-core/test/*.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run test:core && npm run test:server && npm run check:package --workspace tiangz-native-language
